title: Meta picks Pure Storage flash tech for its next-gen data centers

sources.quote: “Pure Storage has achieved another industry first in our journey of data storage innovation with a transformational design win for our DirectFlash technology in a top-four hyperscaler,” said Pure Storage Chairman and CEO Charles Giancarlo.
Pure worked closely with Meta for over a year to qualify our Purity DirectFlash® technology for their next generation data center design.

explain: Pure Storage (now called Everpure) won a 'design win' at Meta: Meta will use Pure's flash-storage technology in its next-generation data centers in place of hard disks, paying Pure license and support fees. Pure first announced it for an unnamed top-four hyperscaler, later naming Meta; no amount was disclosed.
